name: crosstab-table
title: Crosstab table
description: One measure by two dimensions with row, column and grand totals, read as a real table and with an optional five-step shading that never hides the number.
docs: `totals="row"` adds a Total column (the sum of each row), `"column"` adds a Total row (the sum of each column), `"both"` adds both and the grand total. Cells with no value show a dash and are left out of totals and shading. Give `format` as Intl options to use it from a Server Component. The table sits in a labelled region you can focus, so a sideways scroll works with the keyboard.
